{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0]
    if not pts:return out
    if len(pts)==1:
        r,c=pts[0]
        for i in range(len(grid)): out[i][c]=2
        for j in range(len(grid[0])): out[r][j]=2
        return out
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[:2]
    rlo,rhi=sorted((r1,r2)); clo,chi=sorted((c1,c2))
    for i in range(len(grid)):
        out[i][c1]=2; out[i][c2]=2
    for j in range(len(grid[0])):
        out[r1][j]=2; out[r2][j]=2
    for i in range(rlo+1,rhi):
        for j in range(clo+1,chi): out[i][j]=1
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    p=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=0]
    if len(p)==1:
        r,c=p[0]
        for i in range(h): out[i][c]=2
        for j in range(w): out[r][j]=2
    elif len(p)>=2:
        (a,b),(c,d)=p[:2]
        for i in range(h): out[i][b]=out[i][d]=2
        for j in range(w): out[a][j]=out[c][j]=2
        for i in range(min(a,c)+1,max(a,c)):
            for j in range(min(b,d)+1,max(b,d)): out[i][j]=1
    return out"}
